def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    # The drawing is a lattice: separator rows/columns are dominated by one
    # shared line color, while colored intersections encode filled output cells.
    def dense_lines(axis):
        n = h if axis == 0 else w
        m = w if axis == 0 else h
        result = {}
        for color in range(10):
            ids = []
            for i in range(n):
                line = grid[i] if axis == 0 else [grid[r][i] for r in range(h)]
                if line.count(color) >= 0.70 * m:
                    ids.append(i)
            if ids:
                result[color] = ids
        return result

    row_candidates = dense_lines(0)
    col_candidates = dense_lines(1)
    common = set(row_candidates) & set(col_candidates)
    # The lattice color is the non-background color with the fewest dense
    # rows/columns; the large-area fill color produces many more such lines.
    line_color = min(common, key=lambda c: len(row_candidates[c]) + len(col_candidates[c]))
    row_lines = row_candidates[line_color]
    col_lines = col_candidates[line_color]

    # Keep the portion of the lattice spanned by colored intersection marks.
    marks = [(ri, ci, grid[r][c])
             for ri, r in enumerate(row_lines)
             for ci, c in enumerate(col_lines)
             if grid[r][c] != line_color]
    if not marks:
        return []
    rlo, rhi = min(x[0] for x in marks), max(x[0] for x in marks)
    clo, chi = min(x[1] for x in marks), max(x[1] for x in marks)
    rows, cols = row_lines[rlo:rhi+1], col_lines[clo:chi+1]

    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[background for _ in range(len(cols)-1)] for _ in range(len(rows)-1)]
    for i in range(len(rows)-1):
        for j in range(len(cols)-1):
            corners = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            if corners[0] != line_color and all(v == corners[0] for v in corners):
                out[i][j] = corners[0]
    return out
PY
